rig.contentAnchor: Your scoreboard program is built — this part keeps it safe before the Rally. You are going to save a copy into your Google Drive, the same way as last lesson: three steps, about a minute. In a real rally every car is checked in before the race — your RIG is your scoreboard program, and this is its check-in. When the file is in your Drive, press Check my Drive below, and the website will look to make sure it is really there. Then even if a cable is pulled out mid-Rally, your work is safe.
